data.name: Satvir
data.gender_notes: Satvir is used as a masculine name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Satvir is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sat' meaning truth, and 'Vir' meaning hero or brave. Satvir is a name that signifies the qualities of truthfulness and courage in an individual. It suggests that the person named Satvir is someone who is strong, brave, and committed to the truth. The name Satvir carries the meaning “Truth, Satisfaction” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Punjabi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Satvir usually hope their child will grow to embody truth, satisfaction and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It is a name that resonates with the divine energy of the universe and inspires individuals to live a life of truth and authenticity. It is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality and symbolizes the journey towards self-realization and enlightenment.
